form.label: Kong Proxy - Route and Latency Analysis
form.description: Works at two scopes from one page. Leave Route on "All routes" for the cross-cutting latency view; pick a single route to drill into it. Reached from the Service Health Overview matrix, which passes the route through.

search.query: `kong_topology_source` | stats count by service | sort service
`kong_topology_source` | stats count by route | sort route

html.div: Reading latency on Kong 3.4. latencies.kong is plugin and routing overhead plus request receive time, added together in the serializer. Kong 3.5 splits receive time into its own field, so every threshold here shifts on upgrade. latencies.proxy is upstream wait, and -1 means the request never got there - those are excluded from every latency panel below, not counted as zero.

search.query: `kong_base` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | stats count as total, sum(eval(if(status<400,1,0))) as ok | eval pct=if(total>0, round(ok*100/total,2), 100) | fields pct
`kong_proxied` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | stats p95(proxy_ms) as v | eval v=round(v,0)
`kong_proxied` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | stats p95(kong_ms) as v | eval v=round(v,0)
`kong_base` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | stats count as total, sum(retried) as r | eval pct=if(total>0, round(r*100/total,2), 0) | fields pct
`kong_base` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | timechart span=$span$ count by status
`kong_proxied` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | timechart span=$span$ p50(proxy_ms) as p50, p90(proxy_ms) as p90, p95(proxy_ms) as p95, p99(proxy_ms) as p99

html.p: If the red band grows while the blue stays flat, the problem is inside Kong - a plugin, the datastore, or DNS - not the backend.

search.query: `kong_proxied` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | timechart span=$span$ p95(kong_ms) as "Kong overhead p95", p95(proxy_ms) as "Upstream wait p95"

`kong_proxied` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | eval bucket=case(proxy_ms<10,"1: <10ms", proxy_ms<50,"2: 10-50ms", proxy_ms<100,"3: 50-100ms", proxy_ms<250,"4: 100-250ms", proxy_ms<500,"5: 250-500ms", proxy_ms<1000,"6: 0.5-1s", proxy_ms<5000,"7: 1-5s", proxy_ms<30000,"8: 5-30s", true(),"9: >30s") | stats count by bucket | sort bucket

html.p: Each service's own read_timeout is read per-event from service.read_timeout, so a service configured with a 10s timeout is measured against 10s rather than against someone else's 60s. Requests crossing 80% are about to become 504s but have not failed yet, which is the only useful time to know.

search.query: `kong_proxied` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | eval near_timeout = if(isnotnull(read_timeout_ms) AND proxy_ms >= (read_timeout_ms * 0.8), 1, 0) | timechart span=$span$ sum(near_timeout) as "Within 80% of timeout", count as "Total requests"

html.p: This is upstream_uri - the path Kong sent upstream, after rewriting. The raw client path lives in request.uri, which this deployment is not currently emitting (log-format-validation.md finding 1).

search.query: `kong_base` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | stats count as requests, sum(eval(if(status>=400,1,0))) as errors, p50(proxy_ms) as p50_ms, p95(proxy_ms) as p95_ms, p99(proxy_ms) as p99_ms by upstream_path | eval error_pct=round(errors*100/requests,2), p50_ms=round(p50_ms,0), p95_ms=round(p95_ms,0), p99_ms=round(p99_ms,0) | sort - requests | head 25

`kong_base` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | stats count as requests, sum(eval(if(status>=400,1,0))) as errors, dc(upstream_path) as paths, p95(proxy_ms) as p95_ms by client_ip | eval error_pct=round(errors*100/requests,2), p95_ms=round(p95_ms,0) | sort - requests | head 25

panel.title: Kong overhead by route - plugin cost

html.p: Routes with elevated overhead run more or slower plugins. ee-smp-functests carries the rate-limiting plugin, so a rise there can mean the limiter's datastore is slow rather than anything being wrong with the route.

search.query: `kong_proxied` | search $svc$ | stats count as requests, p50(kong_ms) as p50_kong_ms, p95(kong_ms) as p95_kong_ms, max(kong_ms) as max_kong_ms, p95(proxy_ms) as p95_upstream_ms by service, route | eval p50_kong_ms=round(p50_kong_ms,1), p95_kong_ms=round(p95_kong_ms,1), max_kong_ms=round(max_kong_ms,1), p95_upstream_ms=round(p95_upstream_ms,0) | sort - p95_kong_ms

`kong_base` | search $svc$ | search $rt$ | where status>=400 | eval upstream_status=coalesce(upstream_status,"(none)") | table _time, service, route, status, upstream_status, error_source, short_circuited, try_count, proxy_ms, total_ms, client_ip, upstream_path | sort - _time | head 50
